newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's unit in talks to develop casino.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's unit in talks to develop casino.

text.p: Harrah's Entertainment Inc said on Wednesday that a subsidiary has entered into agreements to develop a casino resort in the Philippines.

Specific terms will be the subject of negotiations, which were to begin after Wednesday's signing of a memorandum of understanding between Harrah's subsidiary Golden Fortune Ltd of Hong Kong, and Clark Development Corp, which is owned by the Philippine government.
Clark is overseeing development of a special economic zone at the former U.S. Air Force Base at Clark Field, Philippines, which is 60 miles north of Manila.
The development may involve creating a "Las Vegas style" resort with multiple casinos, hotels, restaurants, retail, recreation and other amenities.
A sports and entertainment arena also is planned.
